reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Technological power concentrated in few hands
themes.definition: Concern that technological and AI power is concentrated among a few corporations and nations, raising questions of control and exclusion.
themes.inclusion: Include passages naming concentration of AI or technological power in a few firms or states.
themes.exclusion: Exclude access-gap arguments without reference to who holds power.
themes.boundary_cases: When concentration is the premise for a governance call, also code AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: a world where technological power is concentrated in the hands of a few corporations and nations

themes.label: Global governance for equitable, ethical AI
themes.definition: Global governance must adapt so AI and new technologies are used equitably, ethically and for human well-being.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for global governance to adapt to AI or ensure its equitable/ethical use.
themes.exclusion: Exclude descriptive statements about AI transforming daily life without a governance call.
themes.boundary_cases: Ethical-use language within a governance call is coded here rather than AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS unless rights are named.

examples.quote: Global governance must adapt to ensure that those technologies are used equitably, ethically and in the service of the well-being of humankind

themes.label: Avoiding deeper inequalities and exclusion
themes.definition: Warning that AI could deepen inequalities or create new forms of exclusion and control.
themes.inclusion: Include warnings that AI will widen inequalities or exclude groups or countries.
themes.exclusion: Exclude concentration claims without an inequality outcome.
themes.boundary_cases: 'New forms of control' may overlap with surveillance concerns; code here when paired with inequality.

examples.quote: rather than deepening inequalities or generating new forms of exclusion and control

value.rationale: The single Bolivia 2024 passage frames AI as a transformative revolution whose power is concentrated among a few corporations and nations, calling for adapted global governance to prevent deeper inequality and exclusion.
